basis: Five complete initial and cross reports; direct raw sources. Fresh verifier is additional, not a substitute for any role challenge.

decisions.conflict: Minimal document clarification versus adding guard/logger/harness implementation or requiring a live pass.
alternatives: New runtime tooling before planning done
Single proposed procedure and source coverage map with future enforcement prerequisites
decisions.selected: Single procedure proposal and offline review; observer owns future enforcement.
decisions.consequence: No application, tooling or input change; actual enforcement remains unknown.
decisions.dissent: Initial prerequisite wording could imply planning block; every cross pass qualifies it.

decisions.conflict: Generic help opening versus full source-defined keyboard help cycle.
alternatives: Explicit summary Enter/open, Space/closed, Enter/reopen before Close
decisions.selected: Explicit three-key cycle and each immediate state.
decisions.consequence: Repairs documentation coverage, not a claimed site bug.
decisions.dissent: UX retains HIGH reliability severity; other roles MEDIUM. Both retained.

decisions.conflict: Simplifying repetitive checks/bound versus preserving existing valid obligations.
alternatives: Merge unanswered assertions or remove bound
Keep both checkpoints, all Back and Close postconditions, and 24 total sequential traversals
decisions.selected: Preserve all; define one traversal key as one step, across directions without reset.
decisions.consequence: Bound is local operational rule; exhaustion is bounded noncompletion, not universal inaccessibility.
decisions.dissent: No sourced reason supports deletion; earlier broad failed/incomplete terminology corrected.

decisions.conflict: Target Close Tab-or-Shift+Tab alternative versus literal contract Close Tab path.
alternatives: Treat Shift+Tab alone as observed Tab
Retain alternative and explicitly distinguish actual path evidence
decisions.selected: Canonical Tab default; preserved labeled Shift+Tab alternative; no mandatory second run. Back either direction remains accepted.
decisions.consequence: Retains valid target allowance while avoiding invented canonical observation.
decisions.dissent: Initial UX/Product broad preservation needed qualification; initial QA checker statement applied Back rule too broadly and is explicitly refuted.

decisions.conflict: All-resource origin ban versus scoped navigation origin guard and all-request methods.
alternatives: Block disallowed methods for all requests and disallowed main-frame/popup navigations
decisions.selected: Separate boundaries and cite profile-only main-frame/popup detail accurately.
decisions.consequence: No invented blanket subresource restriction or guard API; redirects remain subject to navigation guard.
decisions.dissent: Initial Architecture/Delivery raw-source attribution too broad; corrections retained in cross and claims.

decisions.conflict: One generic pass/fail label versus per-obligation evidence and interruption distinctions.
alternatives: Static pass proves journey or all interruption is website failure
Separate actual wrong focus, actual bound exhaustion, and missing observation
decisions.selected: Per-obligation result and actual evidence; downstream unobserved when not executed; blocked analytics effects retained.
decisions.consequence: No fabricated website pass or defect, no guard relaxation, no forced focus rescue.
decisions.dissent: Severity differences retained in full report; no averaging.

boundary_consistency: Contract/policy/profile declarations -> proposed instructions -> future observer guards/actions -> actual evidence -> per-obligation consumer judgments; no storage/schema writers exist in supplied snapshot.
stopping_reason: All mandatory role challenges performed; conflicts resolved by direct evidence and labeling. One Analyze plus one Cross-examine pass, no additional planning round. Empirical questions out of authorized scope remain open.

fresh_verifier.result: 35 IDs: 17 supported, 18 qualified; no unfinished IDs
fresh_verifier.retained_limit: Prior checker execution unresolved within verifier permitted evidence; lead has independent actual command output. Effort unmeasured. Operational taxonomy/counting/redirects are proposals.
